title: PCT_Dev30_v0 combined-candidate model output (Stage 1, v0.2)
description: Successor of pct_dev30_v0_model_output@0.1.0 (unchanged, byte-identical, still valid on its own). The only difference: no candidate or excluded_mention carries evidence_locator / char_start / char_end. The model supplies evidence_quote only; combined_candidate_adapter_v2.py derives exact offsets deterministically by searching the ledger-anchored Item 1 span for all occurrences of the quote (overlap-aware, not str.count) -- zero occurrences refuses (evidence_quote_not_found_in_span), more than one refuses as ambiguous (evidence_quote_ambiguous_in_span), exactly one is accepted. This removes a task (precise character-offset counting over a multi-thousand-word span) that models are unreliable at and that the adapter can already verify deterministically; see ADR-099 for the measured visible-Dev24 evidence this rests on. evidence_quote carries no fixed minimum length beyond minLength: 1 -- specificity is a future prompt instruction, not a schema constraint. Everything else (local-ID staging, kind-discriminated oneOf branches, availability_status vocabulary, zero_candidate_reason biconditional, excluded_mentions shape) is identical to @0.1.0. Dev30-only: legacy_source_id is the legacy-item1:dev30-v0:<hash> namespace and this schema never constructs or accepts a Stage 00C sec-primary: source_id.

availability_status_token.comment: The canonical 8-token vocabulary of docs/methodology/PRODUCT_CAPABILITY_TASK_ONTOLOGY.md, reused verbatim (schemas/product_candidate_availability_vocabulary.schema.json is the governing source; this is a literal, self-contained copy, not a cross-file $ref, matching this repository's existing schema convention).

candidates.comment: Kind-discriminated union, closed per branch. No disposition/exclusion field here -- excluded material lives only in excluded_mentions.

excluded_mentions.comment: Optional and non-exhaustive: not required for every passage considered and rejected. Roadmap/beta claims are never routed here -- they are ordinary candidates carrying a non-GA availability_status.

allOf.comment: candidates == [] iff zero_candidate_reason is non-null. Schema-level defense in depth; the adapter also checks this.
